actions.action: Thin the pot to a single plant by cutting away extra basil stems
Repot into a container of at least 5 gallons with good drainage and high-quality potting soil
If rootbound, gently break up the root ball before potting
Water in after potting: water, let it soak in, then water again
Prune the main stem just above a leaf node to force side shoots, repeating on new growth every few weeks
Cut off flower stalks as they appear

verdict.reason: The answer treats the plant as healthy and focuses on getting bushier growth. Its main advice, pruning to remove flowers and repotting into a large container, matches the fix that worked, and nothing it recommends is harmful.
